name: NetMagic Category Manager for WooCommerce
author: netmagic

sections.description:
NetMagic Category Manager is a WooCommerce category manager for shops with many product categories. It adds one page where you see the whole category tree with product counts, can hide categories from the shop without deleting them, and can import new categories from an Excel file.

Features:

  • Category search box in the product editor
  • Category Manager page: the whole category tree at a glance, with product counts
  • Filter the list by name, or show only hidden, empty or visible categories
  • Hide a category from the storefront without deleting it, and show it again with one click
  • Bulk import categories from Excel (.xlsx, .xls) or CSV — up to 2 levels deep
  • Works with standard WordPress/WooCommerce — no external services required

Pro edition

A separate Pro edition is available from woocatpro.com. It adds drag & drop reordering, inline editing, Excel export and re-import, import up to 10 levels deep, bulk actions, category duplication, safe delete with product move, auto-hide for empty categories, campaign profiles and more. The Pro edition is a separate plugin; this plugin contains no locked features.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/netmagic-category-manager-for-woocommerce directory, or install directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. WooCommerce must be installed and active.
  4. Navigate to Products → Category Manager to get started.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and active. The plugin declares this dependency via the Requires Plugins header.

How many levels can I import?

The import reads two columns: Level 1 (main category) and Level 2 (subcategory). Categories that already exist are skipped, never changed.

I used drag & drop sorting, export or other tools in an earlier version. Where are they?

From version 1.5.13 these tools are part of the separate Pro edition. Nothing was deleted from your site: hidden categories, the saved order, profiles and locks stay in the database and are picked up by the Pro edition.

Does hiding a category affect its URL?

No. Hidden categories are only excluded from WooCommerce shop listings and widgets. The category page itself remains accessible by its URL.
sections.changelog:
1.5.14

  • Fixed: a parent category whose products are all in its subcategories is no longer marked “Empty” (badge, counter and “Empty only” filter)
  • New: screenshots with step-by-step captions for installation and use
  • Clearer description and tags in the plugin directory
  • New: a short, dismissible request for a review on the plugin’s own pages, after the first successful import or 14 days of use. It never appears on other admin pages and does not come back once dismissed
  • Fixed: the “Show product count” setting had no effect; the product editor now shows the number of products next to each category when it is on
  • Fixed: the “Hidden” status icon did not display on systems without full emoji support

1.5.13

  • Changed: the plugin is now available as a free edition (this plugin) and a separate Pro edition
  • The free edition contains: category search in the product editor, the Category Manager overview with hide/show, and Excel import up to 2 levels deep
  • Moved to the Pro edition: drag & drop reordering, inline rename/create/duplicate/delete, bulk actions, Excel export and ID-based re-import, deeper import, auto-hide for empty categories, locks, campaign profiles, feed sources, ghost detector, name mapper, audit log and the image tools
  • Your data is not touched: hidden categories, saved order, profiles and locks remain in the database
  • Fixed: categories without a saved position were missing from the Category Manager list (fresh installs and newly created categories)
  • Fixed: database tables are now created on plugin update as well, not only on activation
  • Improved: hide/show reports an error instead of failing silently

1.5.12

  • Fixed: all issues raised by the WordPress.org plugin review
  • Fixed: profile shortcode name and import variable name in the admin scripts

1.5.10

  • Fixed: Inline
  • Updated: SheetJS vendor library updated from 0.18.5 to 0.20.3
  • Improved: Category Manager JS extracted to external file assets/js/nm-category-manager.js
  • Improved: JS localization object renamed to nmcm for consistency with NetMagic naming convention

1.5.9

  • Added: C11 — Undo Log / Audit Trail (Pro) — every CatPro action is logged to a dedicated DB table (catpro_audit_log)
  • Circular buffer: keeps the last 500 entries; oldest are automatically purged when the limit is exceeded
  • Logged actions: rename, hide, show, delete, lock, unlock, struct_lock, struct_unlock, feed_source_set, feed_source_clear, name_map_apply, bulk actions
  • Admin page (Products → 📋 Audit Log) with filters: action type, user, date, free-text search
  • Colour-coded rows by severity: red for deletes, amber for hides/locks, blue for renames
  • Each row shows: timestamp, action badge, category name + ID, before value, after value, user login
  • Paginated display (50 entries per page) with direct category edit link when the category still exists
  • Clear log button (site admins only) with confirmation prompt

1.5.8

  • Added: C9 — Bulk Name Mapper (Pro) — rename categories in bulk using configurable rules; nothing is hardcoded to any language or vendor
  • Two complementary rename strategies: prefix stripping (e.g. strip “HAFFNER – ” from all matching names) and an exact name→name mapping table
  • Prefix list is fully configurable in the new Name Mapper admin page — add any number of prefixes, in any language
  • Exact name map supports manual entry or upload of a CSV/XLSX file (two columns: old name → new name)
  • Preview page shows all proposed renames before applying — each row has an Include checkbox so individual changes can be deselected
  • Apply step respects struct-locked categories — those are silently skipped
  • Exact name map takes priority over prefix stripping when both rules would match the same category
  • Longest prefix wins when multiple configured prefixes would match the same name
  • New submenu entry: Products → 🔤 Name Mapper

1.5.7

  • Added: C7 — Feed Source Lock (Pro) — assign an external feed source label to any category; feed-owned categories are automatically struct-locked
  • Feed source names are fully configurable in Settings (no hardcoded values) — add as many sources as needed (SellGate, MyFeed, Partner B, etc.)
  • Per-category dropdown in the Category Manager to assign/clear the feed source inline
  • Bulk actions: assign any configured feed source or clear feed source for selected categories
  • Feed source badge (📡 blue) displayed next to the category name in the Manager table
  • New Settings card: “Feed Sources” — define slug + display label pairs with live slug preview
  • Stored as term meta catpro_feed_source; struct lock is set automatically when a source is assigned

1.5.6

  • Added: C5 — Ghost Category Detector (Pro) — new admin page listing all categories with zero products in their entire subtree
  • Ghost categories can be bulk-hidden or bulk-deleted directly from the page
  • Recursive product count engine added to CatPro_Helpers (get_all_recursive_counts()) — walks the full category tree, not just direct children
  • Struct-locked categories are protected from ghost-delete
  • New submenu entry: Products → 👻 Ghost Detector

1.5.5

  • Added: C4a — Structural Lock (Pro) — individually lock categories against rename, delete, move (drag/reparent) and adding child categories
  • Structural lock is separate from the C1 auto-hide lock; stored as catpro_struct_locked term meta
  • Locked rows show an amber 🏛️ Struct Lock badge and highlight; Edit/Subcategory/Delete buttons are disabled per row
  • Toggle button per row + bulk Struct Lock / Struct Unlock in the bulk actions dropdown
  • Server-side guards in rename, delete, create-child and change-parent AJAX handlers

1.5.4

  • Added: C4b — Bulk lock/unlock (Pro) — lock or unlock multiple categories at once via the bulk actions dropdown
  • Added: C2b — ZIP batch image import (Pro) — upload a ZIP file where image filenames match category slugs to auto-assign thumbnails
  • Images are sideloaded into the Media Library and assigned as WooCommerce category thumbnails (thumbnail_id)

1.5.3

  • Added: C3 Campaign Profiles (Pro feature) — save and load category hide/show states as named profiles
  • Added: [catpro_profile name="slug"] shortcode — applies a profile on any page (campaign landing pages, seasonal promos)
  • Added: [catpro_profile name="slug" show_list="yes" columns="3"] — also renders a visual category grid
  • Added: Shortcode copy helper in the Category Manager admin UI
  • Added: Admin bar notice when a profile shortcode is active on a page
  • Profiles stored in wp_options (no database migration required)

1.5.2

  • Added: C1 manual category lock (Pro feature) — protect individual categories from auto-hide
  • Locked categories display a 🔒 badge and blue highlight in the Category Manager
  • Lock state stored in term meta (no database migration required)

1.5.1

  • Renamed plugin to NetMagic Category Manager for WooCommerce
  • Updated text domain to netmagic-category-manager-for-woocommerce
  • Removed bundled translation files (now served via translate.wordpress.org)

1.3.0

  • All features are now available without restrictions
  • Fixed: hidden categories no longer cause 404 errors on their own pages
  • Removed trialware / locked-feature code
  • Improved: inline scripts and styles moved to wp_enqueue system
  • Added: Requires Plugins header for WooCommerce dependency
  • Added: sanitize_callback for all registered settings

1.2.0

  • Added unified export/import format
  • Added inline category editing
  • Added drag & drop reordering

1.1.0

  • Added SheetJS local bundling
  • Added auto-hide visual indicator

1.0.0

  • Initial release

screenshots.caption: Installation: go to Plugins → Add New, search for "NetMagic Category Manager" and click Install Now, then Activate. WooCommerce must be active.
After activation the plugin adds three pages under Products: Category Manager, Import Categories and Cat. Manager Settings.
Category Manager: the whole category tree with product counts. A parent is only marked "Empty" when it has no products in any of its subcategories either.
Hide a category from the storefront with one click, without deleting it. Click Show to bring it back.
Filter by name, or show only hidden, empty or visible categories. The numbers at the top are clickable filters too.
Import categories from Excel: download the template, fill in Level 1 and Level 2, and upload it. The preview shows which categories already exist; those are skipped, never changed.
The import result: how many categories were created and how many were skipped.
Category search in the product editor: type a few letters to find the right category in a long list.
Settings: show or hide the product count next to each category in the product editor.
